moments.selftext: BREAKING: SpaceX now holds all 5 fastest U.S. launch-to-docking times at the International Space Station. 🇺🇸 • Crew-13: 7h 55m (Oct 1, 2026) • CRS-31: 12h 23m • Crew-11: 14h 43m • Ax-2: 15h 35m • Crew-4: 15h 44m All five of these missions flew aboard Dragon spacecraft.
top_comments: I feel like SI is going to have so many good memes.
Fastest docking is not a bigger engine. It is launching into the phasing orbit ISS already agreed to.
Takes longer to get through TSA than it does to reach orbit.
Practice makes perfect… Impressive! SpaceX is on the verge of making humanity a spacefaring civilization!
